Senior Data Engineer, Infosys — May 2020 - Present

Managed code and CI workflows with Git and introduced dbt models for semantic layer consistency.

Developed Python services to process streaming and batch workloads, and authored SQL queries and BigQuery views to support reporting and A/B analysis. Led migration of data pipelines to AWS, leveraging managed services to cut infrastructure costs and improve reliability. Collaborated with stakeholders using Agile processes and tracked work in Confluence; maintained versioned code in Git and created dbt transformations for core data models.
